patch.old:
- name: status
        type: categorical
    measures:
      - name: revenue
        description: "Quantity x price charged."
patch.new:
- name: status
        type: categorical
      - name: unit_price
        type: categorical
        expr: unit_price
    measures:
      - name: revenue
        description: "Quantity x price charged."

patch.text:
- name: premium_completed_revenue
    description: "Completed revenue on lines with unit price at least 100."
    label: "Premium completed revenue"
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: revenue
    filter: "{{ Dimension('sales__status') }} = 'completed' AND {{ Dimension('sales__unit_price') }} >= 100"

- name: french_market_revenue
    description: "Completed revenue of customers in France."
    label: "French market revenue"
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: revenue
    filter: "{{ Dimension('sales__status') }} = 'completed' AND {{ Dimension('customer__country') }} = 'France'"

provenance: E4 candidates M6B (patch ops 1-2) + M2 (patch op 1), applied in that order to pinned upstream 312e97ad. Lab-added native metrics; not an organically maintained enterprise metric.
